notes: m21-fidelity item 4 (2026-10-29). 'If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.' The Ox survives the 3 damage; it dies on the NEXT turn, after the replacement's 'this turn' ended, so it goes to the graveyard. The tree carries no duration: the executor gives a resolving instant's ReplacementAbility an end-of-turn lifetime (stack.py, replacements.register_ephemeral_replacements). Passed before and after the item-4 change; it pins the duration against regression.
